name: Wake Me Up: Move & Rise
subtitle: Alarms with a little sunshine
promotionalText: Give your morning a route: focus, move, and reach a destination. Thirteen challenges, flexible schedules, gentle sounds, and optional wake-up checks. No app login.
description:
Wake Me Up turns a morning alarm into a short route from waking to doing something for your day. Choose up to five steps: a focus task, comfortable movement, and a destination or small real-world action.

BUILD YOUR MORNING ROUTE
Thirteen challenges include push-ups, squats, dance, marching, stretch, breathing, sun taps, typed maths, memory sequences, a typed intention, a barcode or QR destination, letting in light, and preparing a drink. Reorder steps, save reusable routes, or start with a gentle, focus, or joyful preset. Camera push-up and phone motion estimates are optional. Guided counting and comfortable alternatives remain available.

MORE FLEXIBLE WAKE-UPS
Choose weekday repeats, a specific date, or a work/rest cycle. Skip the next occurrence without turning off the series, or change only its time. Add days off, pause for time away, or set a separate quick nap. Native AlarmKit schedules alarms with iOS, including while the app is closed.

Ordinary weekday repeats continue until disabled. Special calendar plans, including rotations, exceptions, pauses, and changing sounds, save fourteen upcoming dates. Open or interact with the app to refill them. Their scheduled-through date is visible; dates beyond that horizon are not yet scheduled.

STAY WITH YOUR MORNING
Enable an optional native wake-up check after completing a route. Confirm three sun taps or cancel it anytime. Choose system snooze duration, or turn snooze off and open the movement action. iOS always retains system dismissal controls; the app cannot force exercise or guarantee that you wake.

SOUNDS AND REST
Six presets draw from three original instrumental tracks. Try changing sounds between mornings, a bundled gentle sound ramp, or local non-DRM audio import. Ritual music has its own volume and mute controls. An optional bedside clock, wind-down reminder, user-chosen rest goal, and Siri shortcuts make daily setup easier. Test sounds on your actual device before relying on them.

YOUR OWN HISTORY
Completed alarm routes add real sunrise entries, step details, optional mood, elapsed route time, and wake-up check confirmation. Practice earns no journal credit. See your last seven days, hide the consecutive-day streak, or export a CSV you choose where to share.

FREE AND PLUS
Free includes two saved alarms, one quick nap, every standard challenge, routes, core scheduling, wake-up checks, sounds, local journal, and standard practice. Plus offers up to twenty saved alarms, adjustable comfortable targets, and longer practice. Apple displays regional monthly and yearly prices; restore purchases in Settings.

No app login, advertising, analytics SDKs, or developer backend. Camera frames are processed on device and never recorded or uploaded. Destination codes use a saved one-way fingerprint. Compatible with iPhone and iPad on iOS/iPadOS 26.1 or later.

reviewNotes:
Build 2 substantially expands this native SwiftUI app after the 4.3 / 4.2.6 rejection. It has not yet been resubmitted. No app login or review account is required.

Create an alarm, build a route of up to five steps, and open each step to choose its task. All thirteen standard challenges and routes are free. New focus tasks require a correct typed sum, a recalled sequence, or a typed intention. Save a destination code under Settings; attach it to a destination step. Matching codes are processed locally. Guided destination and real-world action check-ins are explicitly self-reported; they are not sensor verification.

Allow Alarms to save an enabled alarm. Normal weekday repeats are persistent. Rotations, pauses, exceptions, next-time changes and changing sounds save fourteen fixed dates; the app shows their scheduled-through horizon and refills on app use or an alarm action. iOS keeps its own Stop control. Configure native Snooze and an optional wake-up check in the alarm editor. Completing a real route can schedule a follow-up system alarm; three taps and an explicit confirmation update the existing journal entry. Practice never creates journal credit.

Six sound presets use three licensed original instrumental tracks. Bundled gentle ramps and local non-DRM audio import are available. System sound volume is controlled by iOS; ritual music has separate volume and mute controls. The camera and motion modes are optional on-device estimates, not health assessments. There is no recording, uploading, analytics, advertising SDK or developer backend. Apple handles optional Plus subscriptions; monthly/yearly products provide the same app entitlement.

Automated phone/iPad and signed native alarm checks are documented in the repository. These are not external beta feedback. Physical custom sound/camera/motion checks and genuine TestFlight feedback remain to be collected. Attached WakeMeUp-Build2-Demo.mp4 is a silent simulator recording of the complete three-step practice route, tools and focus screens, native Snooze, an actual alarm ritual, the follow-up alert and explicit awake confirmation. The retained segments play at original speed, with a cut between tests. DEBUG test alarms use fifteen-second scheduling and simulator default sound; the video does not verify hardware audio, camera or movement sensing.
